Compiling a Synapse Agent to wasm32-wasip2 ​

Engineering practice guide. Synapse-supervised agents are compiled to a single .wasm module per agent and loaded by the supervisor (Prefrontal or any other layer-3 project).

0. Why wasm32-wasip2? ​

TargetHTTPThreadsPick?
wasm32-unknown-unknownNoNo (no tokio)❌
wasm32-wasiNo (no wasi:http)Limited❌
wasm32-wasip1wasi:http onlyLimitedOK
wasm32-wasip2wasi:http + components + threadingYes✅ chosen

wasip2 is the only target that gives us:

  • wasi:http outbound (LLM API calls)
  • Stable threading model that matches what tokio expects
  • Componentized imports we need for the synapse:host/* custom imports

1. One-time workspace setup ​

Each Synapse agent lives in its own Cargo workspace so the output .wasm has a clean dependency closure. The template at synapse/templates/agent/ (see 2026-07-01-project-boundary.md) skeletons this for you.

Minimal layout:

my-agent/
├── Cargo.toml
├── src/
│   └── lib.rs
└── wit/                         # optional WIT definition
    └── package.wit

Cargo.toml:

toml
[package]
name = "my-agent"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib"]          # MUST be cdylib for wasm32-wasip2

[dependencies]
synapse = { version = "0.1", default-features = false, features = ["wasm"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
wit-bindgen = "0.30"             # for synapse:host/* ABI generation

[profile.release]
opt-level = "z"                  # Optimize for size
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
strip = true
panic = "abort"

src/lib.rs must cdylib-export the symbols defined in wasm-agent-abi.md:

  • agent_card
  • stream_run
  • cancel_run
  • query_task
  • subscribe_task
  • synapse_abi_version

See the template at synapse/templates/agent/src/lib.rs for the canonical stubs.

2. Building ​

bash
# Install target once per machine
rustup target add wasm32-wasip2

# Debug build
cargo build --target wasm32-wasip2 --release

# Output is at:
#   target/wasm32-wasip2/release/my_agent.wasm
#
# Optionally run `wasm-opt` (binaryen) to shrink further:
#   wasm-opt -Oz target/wasm32-wasip2/release/my_agent.wasm \
#                    -o target/my_agent.optimized.wasm

For CI:

bash
cargo build --release --target wasm32-wasip2 && \
  wasm-opt -Oz target/wasm32-wasip2/release/my_agent.wasm \
            -o dist/my_agent.wasm

3. Verifying the WASM image ​

Synapse CLI helper (planned for the synapse binary, not yet implemented) will run:

bash
synapse agent verify dist/my_agent.wasm
# Expected output:
#   ✓ ABI version = 1
#   ✓ Exports:
#       agent_card          (fn)
#       stream_run          (fn)
#       cancel_run          (fn)
#       query_task          (fn)
#       subscribe_task      (fn)
#       synapse_abi_version (fn)
#   ✓ Imports:
#       wasi:http/outgoing-handler
#       synapse:host/get_config
#       synapse:host/a2a-call
#   ✓ Linear memory range: 1 page..=64 pages

Until the CLI ships, the same verification can be done with wasm-objdump or wasm-tools:

bash
wasm-tools component wit target/my_agent.wasm
wasm-tools print target/my_agent.wasm | grep -E '^\s*\(\s*export|\(import'

4. Loading from a supervisor ​

The supervisor does roughly:

rust,no_run
use synapse::wasm::{WasmRuntime, WasmPackage};

let pkg = WasmPackage::load_wasm_file("dist/my_agent.wasm")?;
let runtime = WasmRuntime::new(synapse::wasm::RuntimeConfig::wasip2())?;
let mut instance = runtime.instantiate(pkg)?;

// Provide host imports at instantiation time
instance.provide_import("synapse:host/get_config", my_get_config)?;
instance.provide_import("synapse:host/a2a-call", my_a2a_call)?;

// Drive it via A2A server executor (see synapse::a2a::server)
let executor = SynapseAgentExecutor::new("agent-1".into(), instance);
let handler = DefaultRequestHandler::new(executor, InMemoryTaskStore::new());
let router = a2a_server::router::build(handler, card);
axum::serve(listener, router).await?;

5. Common pitfalls ​

PitfallSymptomFix
Forgot crate-type = ["cdylib"]wasm-opt complains, no exports visibleAdd it
Used wasm32-wasi targetwasi:http symbols missing, link succeeds but sse_post panics at runtimeSwitch to wasm32-wasip2
Used a non-WASM-aware LLM client (e.g. reqwest)Link-time error from reqwestUse synapse::transport::WasiHttpClient
Bundled a TLS dep that requires native OpenSSLBuild errorStick to rustls-tls only
Used std::thread::spawnRuntime panic (threads not yet on WASM)Use tokio::spawn only; WASM is single-threaded for now
Forgot to declare host importswit-bindgen will fail at link timeSee template wit/ directory
Recursive enable tokio featuresPulls in unsupported process / signalUse tokio = { features = ["rt", "sync", "time", "macros"] } only

6. Testing the WASM image ​

Until the supervisor (Prefrontal) is available, agents can be exercised in three ways:

  1. Native unit tests — keep most agent logic tested natively (cargo test) by mocking the host imports.
  2. Wasmtime direct — use the synapse::wasm::WasmRuntime test harness (tests/wasm_runtime_test.rs) which loads the .wasm file and exercises the exports.
  3. End-to-end A2A test — once a real supervisor is around, send message/send and inspect the response.

7. Versioning ​

  • The WASM ABI may break between Synapse 0.1.x and 0.2.x. Pin your agent's synapse dep tightly during pre-1.0.
  • Once Synapse 1.0 ships, the WASM ABI is stable and agents will continue to load across minor Synapse versions.
